'''Version 1.2.1''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on October 25th 2019.  It was 497.86 KB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

* Fixed [[Primitive Yelloweye|Emana's]] projectile (poison effect duration was always 0)
* Changed Emana's configuration (poison numbers do not multiply)
